observations.value: Decision (accepted Oct 12, 2026): LXD 5.21 LTS and 6.x both offer the required extensions (projects, instance_generation_id), so 5.21 LTS is the minimum version and no extension is added; both refuse TLS 1.2, so the plugin requires TLS 1.3 (Q3).
